text.description_html:
TC2201 Global Door Controls Surface Mount Door Closer

Global Series TC2201 Door Closer is an economically priced door closer for use on both exterior and interior doors in commercial and storefront applications. They fit a common 9 1/6" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Global Series TC2201 Door Closers are non handed and, for standard non-hold open or hold open applications. They can be mounted on regular and top jamb installations. An optional mounting bracket is available for parallel installations.

Also available: ADA Compliant Closer Size 1-4

The TC2201 offering adjustable spring power sizes 2 - 5 for use on doors up to 243 pounds.

Specifications and Features:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 9 7/8"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 9 1/16"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 243 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Spring Size: 2-5
  • Non Handed
  • Grade 3
  • 10 Year Warranty
  • UL 10C Approved

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.

If desired, you can add an optional Parallel Arm Bracket PAB-2200 - AND / OR - Optional Hold Open Arm HOA-1245 below.
